subject: STABLE (host, overlay HEAD+mine): plan memo hit path cheaper (light pre-hash, early-exit compare) + vertex-count canonical; shared tree currently does not build (api_surface.inc fopen/fclose conflicting types - not mine)
body: render_pipeline.inc memo hunks (patch gpu/build/compile-stall-20261026/ov_memo.patch; snapshot commit ee381540 unreferenced): pre-hash now mixes only kind/stage/index/format, extent and non-canonical offset/length of the RAW records (no per-lookup key array, no byte loop); full early-exit per-record compare only for ways whose hash matches; entries with a raw layout slot store hash 0 (always compared). Instruction cost per hit vs HEAD on frame_bench anchors: HEAD 13575 instr/draw (ca200), first 16-way version 14817, now 14121 (+546: 16-way scan, variant memo 8 ways, counters) - device saves ~80 us per avoided miss, so the hit-path cost is noise if the hit rate rises. Exactness: frame_bench anchor ee381540 with TEGU_PLAN_MEMO_VERIFY=1: 0 mismatches; overlay tree (git HEAD + only my hunks of compute_frontend.m/render_pipeline.inc/render_encoder.inc): CA c6f PASS (verify on), async_frontend_test 6/6 asan+release. The SHARED tree fails to compile right now: metal/tegu/api_surface.inc:95/240 conflicting types for fopen/fclose/fwrite/fread (someone's in-flight edit) - owner please fix; also render harness MSAA load_action assert reported earlier.
